findings.title: Publicly logged hostnames suggest exposed admin/legacy/staging systems

evidence.excerpt: CT logs list risky hostname staging.copperline.example with pattern staging, first_seen 2025-03-02, last_seen 2026-09-15; risky_hostnames_count=1, unique_hostnames=12.

findings.deal_impact: A publicly logged staging hostname may expose a less-hardened environment with weaker controls or test data; verify isolation, authentication, and data content before close as a value-protection item.

remediation.summary: Confirm staging host ownership and necessity; restrict to VPN/authenticated access, remove public exposure or retire it, and ensure no production data or credentials are present.
